narrative: Escalation in the Strait of Hormuz after a tanker struck a naval mine dominates weekend headlines, setting up a crude supply shock and defensive posture for the Tokyo open. WTI's push toward $99 is likely to support petro-currencies like CAD and NOK, while safe-haven flows may underpin the greenback. USD/CAD closed Friday at 1.4137, facing downside pressure from energy strength ahead of Monday's Canadian CPI release. Meanwhile, EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1242, where a +145bp OIS carry advantage favors USD and exposes the pair to further downside risk.
